senses.gloss: The twenty-fifth consonant of the Nāgarī alphabet, corresponding to the letter M.

m. (-मः)
1 A name of BRAHMĀ.
2 ŚIVA.
3 VIṢṆU.
4 YAMA.
5 Time, season.
6 Poison, venom.
7 A magical or mystical verse or formula.
8 The moon.
9 The abbreviated name of the fourth note of the gamut.
f. (मा)
1 A name of LAKṢMĪ.
2 A mother.
3 Measure.
4 Light, lustre.
5 Knowledge.
6 Binding, tying.
7 Death.
8 A woman's waist.
n. (मं)
1 Good fortune, auspiciousness.
2 Water.
E.
मा to measure, or मन to worship, &c., aff. ड.

r. 2d cl. (माति) 3d cl. (मिमीते) 4th cl. (मायते)
To mete, to measure: with अनु prefixed, to infer, to conclude: with उप, to resemble; with परि, to measure; with प्र, to be evidence or authority.

ind.
1 A prohibitive and negative particle.
2 A particle implying doubt.
E.
मा to measure, aff. क्विप्; this particle is used chiefly prefixed to verbs, in the imperative mood, as माकुरु do not do (any act), &c., it is also read sometimes, माङ् the final being redundant.
